mix.quadrature: w_m = mu + sqrt(2) s x_m, weights gh_w (omega_m / sqrt(pi), sum 1); P(k) = sum_m gh_w p_m(k), f(rt, k) = sum_m gh_w p_m(k) f_m(rt - t_er | k)
mix.map_rule: c = cumsum(C1, g2..g5) with the middle-out clamp (c4 >= c3 + clamp, c2 <= c3 - clamp, c5 >= c4 + clamp, c1 <= c2 - clamp); v1 = Phi(c1 - w), vk = Phi(ck - w) - Phi(c(k-1) - w), v6 = 1 - Phi(c5 - w); network input v_k = a v_k

response_coding: flow context = standardised race inputs (mix.net_names) then the one-hot of the category k = 1..K; classifier gives K logits, log P(k) = log_softmax
category_map: k = rating_fold(R, RR, K = 3): NEW.3 NEW.2 NEW.1 OLD.1 OLD.2 OLD.3 = r94 R6 1..6
time: the flow models the decision time DT in seconds; rt = DT + U(t0 - st0/2, t0 + st0/2) (exact uniform convolution, conv = {mean: t0, range: st0}, seconds)
